definitions.explanation: Lacking refinement, taste, or intellectual substance. Used to criticize entertainment, humor, or behavior that appeals to base instincts or lacks cultural value.

examples.japanese: {低俗|ていぞく}な⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There are a lot of lowbrow programs.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{低俗|ていぞく}な⟦{記事|きじ}→記事：00227_kiji⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧だ。
examples.english: That magazine is full of nothing but trashy articles.

examples.japanese: {低俗|ていぞく}な⟦{冗談|じょうだん}→冗談：03347_joudan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}く→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: A crude joke ruined the atmosphere.

notes: Strongly negative evaluation word. Common collocations: {低俗|ていぞく}な⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧ (trashy TV show), {低俗|ていぞく}な⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧ (crude/vulgar content), {低俗|ていぞく}な⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧ (lowbrow taste). The opposite is ⟦{高尚|こうしょう}→高尚：14761_koushou⟧ (refined, noble). Compare with ⟦{下品|げひん}→下品：00060_gehin⟧ (vulgar in manners) — {低俗|ていぞく} focuses more on intellectual or cultural lack of quality, while ⟦{下品|げひん}→下品：00060_gehin⟧ focuses on manners and behavior.
